# COMMON COOL — client facts

## Project frame

- Program name: COMMON COOL
- Area: Harbour Ward
- Campaign line: Take a cooler pause.
- Service period: 1 July–31 August 2027
- General offer: Cool indoor seating and drinking water, free of charge.
- Access: No booking. No purchase needed. Everyone is welcome.
- Audience: Residents, outdoor workers and visitors.
- Commissioning teams: Harbour Ward communications staff and venue teams.
- Service records: 03-service-records.en.md; three venues, L1–L3.

## Venue records

| ID | Venue | Address | Regular hours | Facilities | Temporary exception | Opening on exception date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | Loom Library | 14 Harbour Walk | Daily 10:00–18:00 | Cool indoor seating; drinking water; toilets. | Closed on 18 July 2027 for maintenance. | Closed on 18 July 2027. |
| L2 | Depot Hall | 6 Tram Square | Daily 12:00–20:00 | Cool indoor seating; drinking water; phone charging. | Closes at 16:00 on 24 July 2027 for rehearsal. | 24 July 2027: 12:00–16:00; regular opening time 12:00. |
| L3 | Canal Reading Room | 22 Reed Street | Daily 09:00–16:00 | Cool indoor seating; drinking water; toilets; phone charging. | Closed 12:00–14:00 on 5 August 2027 for a workshop. | 5 August 2027: 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00. |

- Shared service period and access terms: Applicable to L1, L2 and L3.
- Regular schedule scope: Every service day other than the stated dated exception.
- Facility sets: The complete facilities listed in each venue row.

## Fixed identity and wording

- Identity asset: 05-common-cool-wordmark.png.
- Wordmark text: COMMON COOL
- Primary color: #143D45
- Background: White, #FFFFFF
- Campaign line: Take a cooler pause.
- Regular schedule label: Regular hours
- Exception label: Temporary change
- Venue cues: L1 with Loom Library; L2 with Depot Hall; L3 with Canal Reading Room.
- Facility vocabulary: Cool indoor seating; drinking water; toilets; phone charging.
- Facility symbol treatment: Symbol paired with facility name.
- Time notation: 24-hour clock.
- Date notation: Day, English month name and year.
- Tone: Calm, respectful and welcoming to people with different daily routines.

## Information hierarchy and content groups

| Priority | Information |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Venue name or directory heading |
| 2 | Usable opening hours and dated temporary change |
| 3 | Address, facilities, general offer and access terms |

- Venue-specific content: Venue identifier, name, address, regular hours, complete facility set, exception date, altered opening status and reason.
- Directory content: All three complete venue records, shared offer and access terms.
- Community change digest content: All three complete venue records, shared offer and access terms; dated changes as leading content.
- Access guide content: Shared offer and access terms; all three venue names and addresses.
- Shared campaign content for street, community and mobile artwork: COMMON COOL; Take a cooler pause.; 1 July–31 August 2027.
- Static application offer and access content: Cool indoor seating and drinking water, free of charge. No booking. No purchase needed. Everyone is welcome.

## Carrier geometry and reading conditions

| Carrier | Finished or logical size | Reading distance | Minimum capital height | Bleed | Safe area |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Street, portrait | A2, 420 × 594 mm | 2 m | Leading venue name or directory heading 20 mm; remaining copy 5 mm | 3 mm | Minimum 5 mm inside trim |
| Street, landscape | A2, 594 × 420 mm | 2 m | Leading venue name or directory heading 20 mm; remaining copy 5 mm | 3 mm | Minimum 5 mm inside trim |
| Community, portrait | A4, 210 × 297 mm | 0.4 m | All text 2 mm | 3 mm | Minimum 5 mm inside trim |
| Mobile, portrait | Logical display area 90 × 160 mm | 0.4 m | All text 1.8 mm | — | 5% inset on each edge |

- Mobile reference raster: 1080 × 1920 pixels.
- Mobile reference safe insets: 54 pixels horizontally; 96 pixels vertically.
- Mobile reference minimum capital height: 22 pixels, corresponding to at least 1.8 mm at the logical display size.
- General text contrast: At least 4.5:1.
- Large heading and meaningful graphic contrast: At least 3:1.
- Street context: Quick reading while passing in bright daylight; place and usable hours as leading information.
- Community context: Close reading of the offer and access terms.
- Mobile context: Static small-screen cards with grouped venue records.
- Overview purpose: Comparison of the three venue records.

## Motion content

- Duration: 10 seconds.
- Source artwork: Mobile three-venue directory.
- Wording source: Mobile three-venue directory.
- First-frame content: COMMON COOL; Take a cooler pause.; 1 July–31 August 2027; Loom Library; Depot Hall; Canal Reading Room.
- Last-frame content: COMMON COOL; Take a cooler pause.; 1 July–31 August 2027; Loom Library; Depot Hall; Canal Reading Room.

## Image records

- 04-reading-frames.png: Dimensioned carrier frames, reading distances and minimum letter heights.
- 05-common-cool-wordmark.png: Existing dark wordmark on white.
- 06-harbour-daylight.png: People and harbor streets in strong daylight; atmosphere reference.

steps.userMessage:
COMMON COOL | Public information for a cooler pause in Harbour Ward

We run COMMON COOL in Harbour Ward and need a coordinated set of street posters, community handouts and mobile information cards for residents, outdoor workers and visitors. The service runs 1 July–31 August 2027, offering cool indoor seating and drinking water free of charge. No booking. No purchase needed. Everyone is welcome. Print "COMMON COOL" and "Take a cooler pause." with the service period on every street, community and mobile artwork and in the video.

Our three venues have different opening hours. L1, Loom Library, 14 Harbour Walk, opens daily 10:00–18:00 and offers cool indoor seating, drinking water and toilets; it is closed on 18 July 2027 for maintenance. L2, Depot Hall, 6 Tram Square, opens daily 12:00–20:00 and offers cool indoor seating, drinking water and phone charging; on 24 July 2027 it opens 12:00–16:00 because of rehearsal. L3, Canal Reading Room, 22 Reed Street, opens daily 09:00–16:00 and offers cool indoor seating, drinking water, toilets and phone charging; a workshop closes it 12:00–14:00 on 5 August 2027, leaving opening periods of 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00 that day.

The direction is fixed: a calm, respectful public-service voice, the attached wordmark, primary color #143D45 and a white background. Use L1, L2 and L3 beside their venue names as recurring identifiers. The hierarchy is place first, usable hours and dated changes second, then address, facilities and access. Label normal schedules "Regular hours" and exceptions "Temporary change"; pair facility symbols with their facility names. Venue-specific pieces carry their complete venue record, including both schedules and the exception reason. Directory overviews and the community change digest carry all three complete records. The access guide carries the shared offer and access terms plus all three venue names and addresses.

Street posters are A2, with 3 mm bleed and a minimum 5 mm safe margin; at a 2 m reading distance, the leading venue name or directory heading has a minimum capital height of 20 mm, with remaining copy at least 5 mm. Community handouts are A4 with the same bleed and safe margin, read at 0.4 m with a minimum capital height of 2 mm throughout. Mobile cards are read at 0.4 m on a logical display area of 90 × 160 mm, with a minimum capital height of 1.8 mm and a 5% inset on every edge. Text contrast is at least 4.5:1; large headings and meaningful graphics reach at least 3:1. Carry these rules into every application.

Audience: Harbour Ward communications staff and venue teams will use the work to approve a public rollout that helps residents, outdoor workers and visitors choose a place and understand when and how to use it.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md holds the fixed identity, service terms and reading requirements. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-service-records.en.md holds the three venue records and their dated exceptions. 04-reading-frames.png provides the carrier geometry, margins and minimum letter heights. 05-common-cool-wordmark.png supplies the existing wordmark to retain across the campaign. 06-harbour-daylight.png provides the bright street conditions and mix of people the materials will reach.

Deliverables:
1. One two-page copy and layout specification containing the information hierarchy table, complete service copy, carrier assignments, physical sizes, bleed, safe margins, grid, type family and weights, minimum letter heights, #143D45 and the two schedule labels
2. Eight A2 street posters: three portrait regular-service posters, three portrait temporary-change posters, one portrait three-venue directory and one landscape three-venue directory
3. Six A4 portrait community handouts: a three-venue directory, an offer and access guide, a three-venue temporary-change digest and three complete venue-specific regular-service sheets
4. Seven portrait mobile cards: a three-venue directory, three venue-specific change cards and three complete venue-specific regular-service cards
5. One 10-second motion extension of the mobile directory, with all three venue names, COMMON COOL, Take a cooler pause. and the service period visible in both its first and last frames
6. One rollout presentation of at least 12 pages, reusing the specification, all street posters, community handouts, mobile cards and video frames, with an index connecting fixed facts to named applications

Acceptance:
- The copy and layout specification comes first and records A2/A4 sizes, #143D45, Regular hours and Temporary change; all street posters and community handouts apply its sizes, color and labels, all mobile cards repeat its color and labels, and the presentation prints these specifications beside reused portrait and landscape examples.
- All twenty-one static applications and the video carry the supplied wordmark, COMMON COOL, Take a cooler pause. and 1 July–31 August 2027; the static applications repeat the shared free offer and access terms, and the presentation repeats the name, campaign line and service period.
- Every venue-specific street poster, community sheet and mobile card carries its complete associated record; both street directories, the community directory, mobile directory and community change digest carry all three complete records. The access guide carries the shared offer, access terms and all three venue names and addresses.
- The three street change posters, three mobile change cards and community change digest foreground Loom Library's closure on 18 July 2027, Depot Hall's 12:00–16:00 opening on 24 July 2027 and Canal Reading Room's 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00 opening on 5 August 2027, with each reason and regular schedule retained.
- Every static application follows its carrier's letter heights, margins and reading distance from the letter, meets the 4.5:1 text and 3:1 large-heading/graphic contrast thresholds, uses venue identifiers with names, and pairs facility symbols with text; the landscape street directory retains the A2 dimensions and 20 mm/5 mm letter heights.
- The video lasts 10 seconds, draws its wording from the mobile directory and carries the five specified content elements in both endpoint frames; the presentation contains at least 12 pages, reuses all twenty-one static applications and both endpoint frames, and locates the three temporary exceptions in its application index.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
